verdict.rationale: uv's docs explicitly describe a global, disk-space-efficient cache used for dependency deduplication across projects (uv-docs-33, uv-docs-25), backed by cache management commands (uv-docs-11/49) and cache-key configuration (uv-docs-26/45). Community reports corroborate real-world disk savings from this shared cache (uv-comm-7), though one user notes an edge case where uvx tool runs sometimes redownload dependencies unexpectedly (uv-comm-4). Missing for 10: first-party technical detail on the content-addressable hashing/dedup mechanism itself, and broader independent benchmarking confirming cross-project dedup at scale.
